## Purpose

This is a summary report for those analyses that contain negative values, to see why they contain negatives and how they should be handled.

```{r}
#| label: outputs
#| fig-show: asis
lengthen_matrix = function(raw_data) {
  raw_df = as.data.frame(raw_data) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "feature_id")
  long_df = raw_df |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -feature_id,
      names_to = "sample_id",
      values_to = "abundance"
    )
  long_df
}
get_info_pieces = function(in_se) {
  # in_se = sets_neg[[1]]
  mwtab_data = metadata(in_se)$mwtab
  analysis_info = mwtab_data$`METABOLOMICS WORKBENCH`
  analysis_info = dplyr::bind_rows(
    analysis_info,
    tibble::tibble(
      field = c("Measurement Type", "N-Samples", "N-Features"),
      value = c(mwtab_data$MEASUREMENT_TYPE, ncol(in_se), nrow(in_se))
    )
  )
  as.data.frame(analysis_info) |> paint::unpaint()
  raw_data = assays(in_se)$raw

  long_data = lengthen_matrix(raw_data)
  long_data = long_data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      adjusted_abundance = abundance +
        (abs(min(abundance, na.rm = TRUE)))
    )
  raw_boxplot = long_data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = sample_id, y = abundance)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(subtitle = paste0(mwtab_data$ID, " Raw"))
  print(raw_boxplot)

  log_boxplot = long_data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = sample_id, y = log1p(abundance))) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(subtitle = paste0(mwtab_data$ID, " Raw"))
  print(log_boxplot)

  adj_raw_boxplot = long_data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = sample_id, y = adjusted_abundance)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(subtitle = paste0(mwtab_data$ID, " Adjusted"))
  print(adj_raw_boxplot)

  adj_log_boxplot = long_data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = sample_id, y = log1p(adjusted_abundance))) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(subtitle = paste0(mwtab_data$ID, " Adjusted"))
  print(adj_log_boxplot)

  n_miss = long_data |>
    dplyr::filter(is.na(abundance)) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_missing = dplyr::n(), .by = sample_id)
  n_neg = long_data |>
    dplyr::filter(abundance < 0) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_negative = dplyr::n(), .by = sample_id)

  missing_boxplot = n_miss |>
    ggplot(aes(x = n_missing)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
    labs(subtitle = mwtab_data$ID)
  print(missing_boxplot)

  negative_boxplot = n_neg |>
    ggplot(aes(x = n_negative)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
    labs(subtitle = mwtab_data$ID)
  print(negative_boxplot)
}

purrr::walk(sets_neg, get_info_pieces)
```
